description: Each kithd generates a self-signed TLS cert at first run (already does this for Tailscale). For non-Tailscale transports, the cert's public key becomes the peer's identity. identify_caller extracts identity from the client certificate presented during mTLS handshake. Requires out-of-band fingerprint exchange or TOFU for initial trust establishment. Simplest mTLS path — no CA, no ACME, no DNS records. Good for LAN/mesh deployments.
title: Auth mechanism: self-signed TLS certs
